top.name: Foregone Conclusion
top.rules_text: Choose a tile within 4. At the end of each of the next 2 turns: deal 3 damage to whatever stands there.

bottom.name: Read Ahead
bottom.rules_text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Keep 1. The rest go to the bottom.

upgrades.description: The conclusion arrives harder, and you read further ahead.
